title: The DNA Kits Behind Viral Celebrity Family Reveals Are 65% Off Right Now: Shop Ancestry.com Deals Here
summary: From Oct. 30 to Nov. 19, Ancestry.com is offering 30% off gift memberships and 65% off DNA kits.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

What if your family history had a plot twist worthy of reality TV? In recent years, DNA testing has surged in popularity, fueled by genealogy shows like Finding Your Roots and celebrity revelations, such as Justin Bieber discovering a distant family connection to Avril Lavigne and Lance Bass learning that Britney Spears is his sixth cousin . Add to that the countless TikToks featuring people uncovering jaw-dropping truths about their genetic makeup, and it’s easy to see why you might have a serious case of FOMO for this pop-culture craze.

For holiday shoppers ready to explore their own origins, or give someone else the chance to discover theirs, Ancestry is offering a limited-time deal through Nov. 19. Shoppers can get 65% off AncestryDNA kits and 30% off gift memberships , a significant markdown from their usual prices, and just in time for the holiday season.

DNA KITS

AncestryDNA Kits

Save 65%

get ancestrydna

The standard AncestryDNA Kit includes an origins report covering more than 4,800 places worldwide, potential genetic relative matches and insights into 93 African ethnic groups.

For shoppers looking to go further, the AncestryDNA + World Explorer Membership Kit combines DNA testing with a family history subscription and access to historical records. The AncestryDNA + All Access Membership Kit adds a three-month subscription and allows up to four additional accounts, with access to Newspapers.com articles and Fold3 military records, a feature utilized by Lance Bass to learn about his paternal grandfather’s WWII service .

Note that AncestryDNA results explore ancestry and relatives, while Ancestry’s optional Traits kit examines characteristics associated with DNA, including certain performance, personality, and physical traits.

GIFT MEMBERSHIPS

Ancestry Gift Memberships

Save 30%

get ancestry gift membership

Ancestry’s U.S. Discovery membership helps recipients investigate American family history through records spanning all 50 states, with six- and 12-month options.

A World Explorer membership expands the search to U.S. and international records from more than 80 countries. Moreover, All Access membership includes Ancestry’s records alongside military archives on Fold3 and newspaper content on Newspapers.com. Gift memberships are prepaid, do not automatically renew and can be delivered by email on a date selected by the purchaser, making them a flexible option for holiday gifting.

Difference Between AncestryDNA and an Ancestry Membership

AncestryDNA helps you explore your genetic heritage through ethnicity estimates, DNA matches and potential ancestral migration paths. It offers insights into where your ancestors may have lived and helps you connect with relatives who share your DNA.

An Ancestry membership focuses on family history research, allowing you to build a family tree, search historical records, explore public family trees and uncover details about your ancestors’ lives through hints and interactive timelines.

Set Up Your Ancestry DNA Kit in a Few Simple Steps

After ordering a kit, customers register it online, provide a saliva sample using the included collection tube and mail it to the lab in the prepaid return package. Ancestry says results typically arrive within six weeks of the lab receiving the sample and customers receive an email when their results are ready to explore online.
